svg.title: Net backtest return of the one surviving book, by period
svg.desc: Bar chart of the surviving book's net return after costs and funding, in basis points of capital per day, with HAC t-statistics. Development years: 2023 6.4 (t 1.79), 2024 7.8 (t 1.89), 2025 19.2 (t 3.98). The 2026 holdout, January to September: 23.0 (t 2.61). Its clean slice, July to September 2026: 9.1 (t 0.90). Only 2025 and the 2026 holdout clear t = 2; the clean slice does not.
